  - [**Centralized Feedback:** Customer feedback is scattered, causing confusion (e.g., the Kohlbecker support case). Adrian will evaluate open-source CRMs like Odoo to create a single source of truth for all communication.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=464.0)
  - [**Critical Feature Requests:** Users are requesting multi-currency support and import/export functions. These are blockers for user adoption, as one prospect (Günther) will switch from Excel only if these features are added.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1757.0)
  - [**Sales Momentum:** Recent holiday sales (3 new subscriptions) and a user referral (Kohlbecker → Simon) show positive traction. The immediate priority is sales and marketing to build on this momentum.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=781.0)
  - [**ByteClub as a Model:** Adrian's other project, ByteClub, validates a high-margin SaaS model with €800 MRR on only \~$2/month in infrastructure costs, providing a clear benchmark for Mindtreasher's potential.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)

## Topics

### User Feedback & Centralization

  - [**Problem:** Customer feedback is scattered across channels (e.g., `review-request` channel), making it difficult to track and act on.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=464.0)
  - [**Impact:** This leads to inefficient support (e.g., the Kohlbecker case involving 15 people) and risks losing valuable insights.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=540.0)
  - [**Solution:** Adrian will evaluate open-source CRMs like Odoo to centralize all communication.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1889.0)
      - [**Rationale:** Odoo is a comprehensive ERP/CRM with Stripe webhook integration, which is critical for automating sales and support workflows.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1889.0)

### Feature Requests: Multi-Currency & Import/Export

  - [**Multi-Currency Support:**](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=993.0)
      - [**Trigger:** A new user (Simon, referred by Kohlbecker) requested support for Hong Kong Dollars (HKD).](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=874.0)
      - [**Impact:** This is a key blocker for user adoption. A prospect (Günther) will switch from Excel only if this feature is implemented, along with import/export.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1757.0)
      - [**Complexity:** A simple currency dropdown is insufficient. The feature requires real-time conversion for dashboard totals and future tax reporting, which necessitates a dedicated API.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1820.0)
  - [**Import/Export Functionality:**](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1757.0)
      - [**Trigger:** Günther's request.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1757.0)
      - [**Impact:** This is a standard feature for users migrating from Excel and is a prerequisite for adoption.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1757.0)

### Sales & Marketing Momentum

  - [**Holiday Sales:** 3 new subscriptions were acquired over the holidays.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=781.0)
      - [**New Users:** Nadine Randholz (monthly), Kohlbecker (annual), and one other.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=781.0)
  - [**User Referrals:** Kohlbecker referred a new user, Simon, demonstrating the power of word-of-mouth marketing.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=874.0)
  - [**Marketing Initiatives:**](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1480.0)
      - [**Fathom Partnership:** Secured an affiliate deal for the journal with the P\&M team, leveraging the new Clever Options course launch.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=220.0)
      - [**Markus Collaboration:** A meeting is set for Monday to discuss marketing strategies, including a video course, blog posts, and a YouTube series.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1480.0)

### Operational & Financial Admin

  - [**Invoicing:**](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=291.0)
      - [**Problem:** Stripe subscriptions are not generating proper invoices with VAT details, creating a bookkeeping issue for Herrlitz.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=291.0)
      - [**Action:** Larissa will clarify the exact requirements with Herrlitz.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=326.0)
      - [**Workaround:** For discounts, apply the amount upfront and issue a single invoice for the net total to simplify bookkeeping.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=387.0)
  - [**Phenom Invoicing Tool:**](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=349.0)
      - [**Limitation:** Cannot apply general discounts; they must be tied to a specific product.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=349.0)
      - [**Decision:** Continue using Phenom for now, as its limitations are manageable for the current volume.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=450.0)

### ByteClub as a Model

  - [**Performance:** Adrian's other project, ByteClub, validates a high-margin SaaS model.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
      - [**MRR:** €800](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1307.0)
      - [**Infrastructure Costs:** \~$2/month](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1554.0)
  - [**Growth Strategy:** ByteClub is currently focused on sales to acquire new customers beyond its initial client, Kasach.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1307.0)
  - [**Mindtreasher Parallels:**](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1149.0)
      - [**Pricing:** A 20% finder's fee will be offered for new customers.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1149.0)
      - [**Company Structure:** The project will remain under Mindtreasher GmbH until it has 2-3 significant customers, deferring the cost and complexity of a new entity.](https://fathom.video/share/HtTSdNS4yCo4JzJ2dfFpyHnTxRY3c5CR?tab=summary&timestamp=1163.0)
